title: Daily Signal Brief 021 — Mobley wave hits procurement; Stratum's lane is the new buyer checklist
summary: The Mobley/Lin FEHA-agent ruling crossed from legal-trade to general-business with a concrete procurement instruction: Startup Fortune tells enterprise HR-tech buyers to renegotiate contracts and indemnification clauses now, naming Workday, HireVue, Eightfold, Pymetrics, and circulating a four-item buyer checklist (audit rights, bias-testing documentation, clear indemnity language, data-source explanations) that maps almost line-for-line to what Stratum has published since Engineering Post 05. Recommendation: Compass + Forge ship a procurement-aimed one-pager by Thursday EOD; Vector forwards to Cordova / Halcyon / Mercator / Northwind / Atlas; Forge + Kernel hold Friday eval-set v1.2 publish with a four-item crosswalk added. Plus: Mordor Intelligence's 181-page composable-HCM market report dated today projects $9.09B (2025) → $27.37B (2031) at 20.46% CAGR — third-party validation of Stratum's modular thesis, Helm + Compass plan analyst-relations outreach. Plus: Lattiverse '26 full roster swept (closes yesterday's 12-day source-coverage debt) — Lattice's vendor-controlled-training-data answer to the audit question contrasts with Stratum's published-methodology answer; Kernel + Forge owe a one-page eval comparison this week.
